name: app-black-results-slide-with-cream-stats-card
title: Black Results Slide with Cream Stats Card
whatItIs: A black slide titled Results with a dark card showing 6 weeks concept to final design, a paragraph in white and grey, and a large cream card with 12 key actions on the home screen, and stats for 2 taps, 94% completion and 4.8 satisfaction.
whatItMeans: Big light numerals on black and cream make results calm and legible, and a cream card lifts the key claims.
techniques: Large light numerals as the stats
Dark card and light card in contrast

vocabulary.definition: Three key numbers with short captions in a row.
A dark card and a light card set side by side.
A slide summarising outcomes of a project.
